# League of Legends Champion Set Tracker

> A free web tool for tracking progress through custom League of Legends champion sets:
> mastery goals, one trick rotations, challenge runs, Arena God, ARAM sets and ranked champion pools.

The in game mastery screen shows a per champion mastery number. It does not let you define your
own set of champions and track progress against it. This tool does, and it needs no account.

## What it does
- Define a custom set of champions, any size, for any goal
- Track progress against that set across the full current champion roster
- Filter the roster and drive the whole interface from a command palette
- Works in the browser with no signup

## What it is not
- Not a match history or stats site. For per game analytics, use op.gg, u.gg or Mobalytics.
- League of Legends Champion Set Tracker was created under Riot Games' "Legal Jibber Jabber"
  policy using assets owned by Riot Games. Riot Games does not endorse or sponsor this project.

## Pricing
Free. Everything is free. Supported by Ko-fi.
